movement_profile.formation_and_space: Performers move in a group from house to house and dance in a circle around a central lamp.

signature_moves.description: The Sanyasi character roams the courtyard independently while holding a symbolic phallus made of tied wooden sticks.
signature_moves.name: Sanyasi Roam

music_profile.sound_description: The sound is defined by the loud, rhythmic chanting of 'Ḍimbisāle' as the troupe travels, followed by singing and the sound of the conch and drum during the courtyard performance.
music_profile.vocal_style: Chanting and singing of traditional verses.

basic_steps: Gathering at a holy place for prayer
Moving in a group from house to house
Setting up a lamp in the center of the courtyard
Dancing in a circle around the lit lamp
Enacting mythological roles through mimicry and song
teaching.formation: Group formation around a central lamp in a courtyard.
